issue_signals.title: 12G-SDI Port Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Shock
issue_signals.description: Connecting SDI cables while powered on or using unshielded D-Tap splitters causes ground loops that blow the internal SDI driver chip.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: MANDATORY ORDER OF CONNECTION: Power cable FIRST, SDI cable SECOND. When disconnecting: SDI cable FIRST, Power cable LAST. Never connect or disconnect SDI while camera or monitor is powered.
issue_signals.source_type: Manufacturer RED Technical Bulletin + B&H Community Q&A

issue_signals.title: Camera Mount Flange Distortion & Optical Misalignment
issue_signals.description: Due to massive 2.8kg - 3.1kg weight, operating without rigid 15mm/19mm lens support bends the camera mount or adapter flange, causing uneven focus across frame and permanent body damage.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: HARD BLOCK in complete_kit(): Must require 15mm baseplate, rods, and lens support bracket. Staff inspection must verify bracket is locked before dispatch.

issue_signals.product: Accsoon CineView M7 Pro / Hollyland Transmitters
issue_signals.title: Missing / Damaged Detachable RP-SMA Antennas
issue_signals.description: Clients frequently misplace or unscrew antennas, or pack antennas loosely in bags where connector pins snap.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: Dispatch and return checklist must require physical antenna count verification (4 antennas per M7 Pro). Missing antenna billed at NPR 1,500 each.
issue_signals.source_type: Babin Dispute Log + Rental House Forum

issue_signals.title: Frame Dropping / Write Abort in S&Q 120fps All-Intra
issue_signals.description: Using standard V60 or uncertified V90 SD cards in 4K 120p All-Intra causes write-buffer overflow and camera recording abortion.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: High-frame-rate 120fps bookings MUST mandate Sony TOUGH CFexpress Type A cards (VPG200 certified).
issue_signals.source_type: Sony Technical Support Bulletin + B&H Verified Reviews

issue_signals.title: Motor Overheating and Axis Shudder due to Lazy Balancing
issue_signals.description: Beginners attempt to compensate for poor mechanical balance by maxing out motor stiffness, resulting in high-frequency motor vibration and eventual thermal shutdown.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: Pre-flight test: Gimbal must balance perfectly at 45-degree angles on all 3 axes with motors completely OFF before power-up.

issue_signals.title: Domestic Socket Overload / Plug Melt
issue_signals.description: Running 720W continuous fixture alongside hair dryers, kettles, or domestic loads on a 5A Nepali wall outlet causes breaker trips or socket pin scorching.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: Must supply dedicated heavy-duty 15A three-pin power cable; instruct gaffer/client on breaker check.

issue_signals.title: Severe Rolling Shutter (26.8ms) & Passive Thermal Accumulation
issue_signals.description: CineD lab tests measure 26.8ms readout in 4K Full Frame (causing heavy jello on whip pans). DPReview confirms 33MP oversampling creates heavy processor heat in continuous takes over 45 minutes.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: For dynamic movement/car rigs, do NOT recommend A7 IV in FF mode; switch to S35 crop (13.0ms) or recommend FX3 (8.7ms) / Komodo-X (0ms). For long takes, mandate Auto Power OFF Temp: High and keep LCD extended from body.
issue_signals.source_type: CineD Lab Test + DPReview In-Depth Review

issue_signals.product: Blazar Mantis 1.33x & Great Joy 1.8x Anamorphic Sets
issue_signals.title: Distorted Aspect Ratio Framing due to Missing Monitor De-Squeeze
issue_signals.description: Shooting anamorphic without on-set de-squeeze preview forces directors and DPs to frame compressed subjects, leading to poor composition and framing errors.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: Every anamorphic lens booking MUST include an external monitor supporting hardware de-squeeze (Accsoon M7 Pro with 1.33x/1.8x or Desview S14-HDR).
issue_signals.source_type: Newsshooter Anamorphic Reviews + Y.M.Cinema Field Analysis

issue_signals.title: Black Shading Fixed-Pattern Noise on Temperature Drift
issue_signals.description: When shooting environments shift by >15°C (e.g. Kathmandu 25°C to Mustang 5°C), sensor calibration drifts, resulting in fixed-pattern noise in dark midtones.
issue_signals.mitigation_rule: Client must be briefed to perform an in-camera Black Shading Calibration once the camera reaches operating equilibrium at the shoot location.
issue_signals.source_type: RED Technical Operations Manual + CineD Lab Test
